data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin that extracts basic metadata from local video files on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It uses the native MediaMetadataRetriever (Android) and equivalent iOS APIs to read title, path, author, mimetype, dimensions, filesize, duration, orientation, creation date, framerate and location of a video file. The data is returned as a simple Dart object.
use_when: You need to display or process video file information such as duration or resolution before playback
You need to store or sort local videos based on their metadata
avoid_when: You require video streaming or remote URL metadata
You need advanced video processing or editing capabilities
You target platforms other than Android or iOS
weaknesses: Works only with local file paths
Limited to the listed metadata fields
May require additional permissions on Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Add NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription (and other needed keys) to iOS Info.plist; ensure appropriate Android permissions (e.g., READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) for accessing video files
